baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired verbs yufuna and la yanquduna governing God's ahd and the mithaq.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fulfillment supplies positive, repeated completion while non-breach guards an achieved, tightened structure from being unwoven; the clauses are complementary rather than redundant.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficit makes fulfillment an active delivery of the bond's whole due.
Repeated preservation makes the covenant an object of continuing care rather than a past utterance.
Undoing something woven or built gives breach the mechanics of dismantling achieved coherence.
Tightening and strengthening supplies the compact's load-bearing integrity.

changed_reading.before: Keep a promise and do not violate it.
changed_reading.after: Continually bring an entrusted bond to full performance while preserving its constructed integrity from unraveling.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ahd Allah as the object fully discharged and mithaq as its confirmed form.
baseline_models.mechanism: A prior instruction is deposited for preservation, warranty or recourse makes performance auditable, and fulfillment discharges the whole due.

activation_trace.role: A prior instruction entrusted for safekeeping turns the covenant into a mandate awaiting enactment.
Warranty and possible recourse make the entrusted obligation answerable rather than merely aspirational.
A confirmed compact supplies the mandate's formal binding force.
Whole completion functions as full discharge of what was entrusted.

changed_reading.after: A deposited divine mandate is fully discharged under a bond that preserves accountability and recourse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Yufuna read through arrival at an appointment, with ahd as a known locus and mithaq as trusted reliance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival at the appointed gathering, return to a familiar place, and settled reliance turn covenant fidelity into directed movement toward a trusted rendezvous.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at an agreed appointment makes fulfillment punctual presence, not only propositional compliance.
A known place returned to gives the covenant a stable destination of recognition.
Settled reliance makes that destination one approached in trust.

changed_reading.before: The covenant is a static verbal bond.
changed_reading.after: The covenant orients a return and is fulfilled by arriving at its trusted appointment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: La yanquduna read through the creaking-under-weight branch beside the compact's structural strength.
baseline_models.mechanism: A tightened bond bears pressure; the negation can distinguish actual rupture from the audible strain that precedes it.

activation_trace.role: Creaking joints or a back under burden introduces strain as a state short of structural failure.
Tight structural strength makes the compact capable of carrying pressure.

changed_reading.before: Non-breach means the obligation encounters no disruptive force.
changed_reading.after: Fidelity means the bond remains intact under load; strain may be heard without becoming rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive continuation into joining and the exact negative mirror that moves from breach to severance to corruption make covenant integrity the support for a wider relational and terrestrial network.

activation_trace.role: Unweaving the built bond supplies the initiating failure in the focus clause.
Uninterrupted continuation without cutting turns fulfillment outward into maintained connection.
The mirrored act of dismantling repeats the focus failure on the negative side of the sequence.
Estrangement and cutting connection expose breach's social propagation.
Departure from sound order marks the network-level result of severed bonds.

structural_cues: 13:20-22 repeat the relative-clause subject while expanding from covenant to connection, fear, patience, prayer, spending, and repelling harm.
13:25 reverses the wording of 13:20 and immediately couples breach with cutting and corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a positive joining sequence and a mirrored breach-severance-corruption sequence; I infer that covenant integrity conditions relational continuity; a live alternative is that the clauses simply enumerate independent virtues and faults.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes private reliability toward one compact.
changed_reading.after: The verse names maintenance of connective infrastructure whose breach propagates into estrangement and damaged common order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wound-reopening branch of breach meets continued connection, reconciliation, family inclusion, and the opposite act of cutting, yielding a restorative model in which fidelity keeps a repaired relation from opening again.

activation_trace.role: A healed wound reopening gives non-breach the specific function of preserving repair.
Continuing relationship and refusing estrangement supplies the maintenance behavior after repair.
Removal of aversion between people activates reconciliation within the family-entry scene.
Severing connection supplies the exact reversal that can reopen settled relations.

structural_cues: The branchless د ر ء clause in 13:22 places repelling harm with good between covenant fidelity and family inclusion.
13:23 gathers repaired or fit ancestors, spouses, and descendants into one destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reopening, continued connection, reconciliation, and family gathering; I infer a repaired relation that fidelity keeps closed; a live alternative is that 13:23's صلاح denotes moral fitness only, not interpersonal reconciliation.

changed_reading.before: Do not commit a fresh violation of a standing contract.
changed_reading.after: Do not reopen what has been healed; covenant fidelity includes sustained maintenance of repaired relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heavy cloud, a torrent carrying material, and hardship that splits the self amplify the focus image of a compact whose joints can sound under burden without actually giving way.

activation_trace.role: Creaking under burden distinguishes experienced strain from completed rupture.
Structural tightening gives the compact capacity to bear what presses on it.
Literal heaviness supplies environmental pressure before the focus sequence.
Visible carrying by the torrent supplies a moving load rather than static weight.
Weight that splits the self establishes the limiting case where pressure becomes fracture.

structural_cues: The focus stands after scenes of heavy cloud, thunder, failed grasping, flood, smelting, and bad account.
Patience immediately follows covenant and connection in 13:22, keeping endurance adjacent to integrity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heaviness, carrying, creaking, and splitting; I infer a threshold between strain and failure; a live alternative is that these material pressures are unrelated scenes and the focus negation simply prohibits annulment.

changed_reading.before: A faithful bond is imagined as untroubled and silent.
changed_reading.after: A faithful bond may creak under accumulated pressure; the ethical threshold is rupture, not the mere presence of strain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rain branch within ahd is activated by apportioned irrigation, one water producing varied growth, measured valley channels, beneficial residue, and lasting garden yield; fulfillment becomes recurrent replenishment and non-breach protects the channel.

activation_trace.role: Rain that revisits already wetted ground makes covenant care recurrent rather than one-time.
Full delivery becomes completion of the due allotment of sustaining water.
An irrigation share and its channel supply an apportioned path of replenishment.
The common water source supplies one sustaining medium across differentiated recipients.
A valley as the flood's course turns continuity into channel integrity.
Each thing reaching its measured limit makes replenishment proportionate rather than indiscriminate.
Benefit opposed to harm identifies the retained yield of an intact channel.
Stable remaining with waiting gives the beneficial deposit temporal endurance.
Continuance makes the final yield persistent rather than seasonal exhaustion.

structural_cues: 13:3-4, 13:17, and 13:35 repeatedly coordinate land, water, differentiated capacity, retained benefit, and enduring produce.
13:25 couples covenant breach with corruption in the earth, supplying the ecological reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ahd's revisiting-rain branch and a repeated water-channel-yield sequence; I infer irrigation as a functional analogy for covenant maintenance; a live alternative is that the ecological material remains independent cosmological evidence.

changed_reading.before: Covenant fidelity is a single legal performance.
changed_reading.after: Covenant fidelity is recurrent, measured replenishment that keeps a shared channel productive across unequal capacities.

context_deltas.mechanism: Running to an appointed term, anticipated meeting, a promise that does not miss its appointment, and a record for every term sharpen the focus arrival branch into punctual covenant performance.

activation_trace.role: Coming to the agreed appointment supplies the focus's punctual mode of fulfillment.
A known locus of return makes the appointment recognizable rather than arbitrary.
A fixed limit of time gives cosmic motion a due point of arrival.
Two parties coming face to face supplies the rendezvous toward which fulfillment moves.
A promise fixed to time or place makes the divine appointment explicit.
A promise failing to occur on time defines the temporal breach explicitly denied in context.
The repeated fixed term confirms due-time structure across the surah.
An inscription that imposes rule or measure records each term as binding.

structural_cues: 13:2 and 13:38 repeat the appointed-term construction around ordered motion and written determination.
13:31 places promised arrival and non-failure of the appointment in one clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointed terms, meeting, inscription, and the focus arrival branch; I infer that timeliness is part of covenant completion; a live alternative is the focus root's more ordinary whole-quantity completion without rendezvous force.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment preserves the content of a promise whenever it is eventually performed.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment arrives at the recognized due point; keeping time and meeting the appointment belong to the covenant's substance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same focus root later names the taking of a life while promised outcomes may remain unseen and duty is separated from account; this activates fulfillment as longitudinal completion of an entrusted finite life rather than control of every result.

activation_trace.role: Whole completion anchors covenant performance as rendering the full entrusted due.
Taking the soul activates a finite life-span boundary for what can be fully discharged.
A threatened future that may or may not be witnessed separates faithful duty from observed outcome.
Counting and account locate final reckoning beyond the agent's assigned delivery.

structural_cues: 13:40 disjoins seeing some promised outcome from being taken and then divides communication from accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root in completion and soul-taking senses plus a duty-account division; I infer a whole-life horizon for covenant discharge; a live alternative is that the death sense remains local to 13:40 and does not revise 13:20.

changed_reading.before: Fidelity is judged by producing the promised external outcome.
changed_reading.after: Fidelity is full discharge of entrusted duty across a finite life, even when outcome and final account remain outside the agent's control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate knowledge and recollection before the focus activate ahd's preserved trace of encounter, while later remembrance settling hearts makes covenant action the behavioral persistence of recognized truth.

activation_trace.role: A prior encounter or state preserved in knowledge makes the covenant a durable recognition.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the recognized truth immediately preceding covenant conduct.
Recall after or against forgetting makes recognition actively recoverable.
Repeated remembrance keeps the recognized relation present across time.
Settling and tranquility supply the stabilizing effect of sustained remembrance.

structural_cues: 13:19 moves directly from knowing and recollecting to the relative clause of 13:20.
The repeated alladhina clauses make knowledge, covenant conduct, connection, and patience successive manifestations of one remembered orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowledge, recollection, a preserved encounter trace, and settled hearts; I infer that memory stabilizes covenant performance; a live alternative is that these are adjacent qualities without a causal mnemonic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The covenant is an external document obeyed from outside.
changed_reading.after: The covenant is recognized truth kept present in memory until it becomes stable conduct.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the compact's material binding branch to punitive collars and the willing-forced spectrum; it remains anchored in mithaq and exact contextual binding cues, but downstream prose should present it only as an agency-and-restraint analogy, not as a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-mithaq through the material binding branch of و ث ق.

activation_trace.role: A cord or fastening makes the compact materially capable of restraining.
A collar that binds an organ supplies the punitive external counterpart to covenantal self-binding.
Willing compliance supplies agency within binding.
Compelling another into the disliked action supplies the opposing forced mode.

changed_reading.before: Every binding image merely intensifies obligation.
changed_reading.after: The compact can be carried as chosen self-binding, contrasted with the external restraint that follows refusal; agency changes the bond's mode.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly branch-distant because the earth-opening sense of ن ق ض is not the ordinary covenant sense; it remains anchored in the focus root and a sequence of stabilized, cut, and edge-diminished earth, but downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial systems analogy rather than a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: La yanquduna through the branch in which earth opens, with mithaq treated as common ground.

activation_trace.role: Ground opening from below supplies a fissure model for breach.
Firm anchoring supplies the opposite condition of stable shared ground.
Severing the earth gives fissure a large-scale spatial consequence.
Loss of part of a whole supplies progressive contraction after a breach.
The edge or limit locates where loss becomes visible first.

changed_reading.before: Breach is only a legal cancellation between parties.
changed_reading.after: Breach can be modeled as a fissure in common ground: once continuity opens, loss advances from the edges of the shared field.

strongest_changes: The 13:20-25 positive and negative mirror recasts covenant fidelity as maintenance of connective infrastructure, with breach propagating into severance and corruption.
Appointment, meeting, inscription, and non-failure of the due time turn fulfillment into punctual arrival while the later soul-taking use keeps a distinct whole-life discharge reading live.
Material branches preserve coexisting repair, load, irrigation, chosen-binding, and common-ground readings instead of reducing the verse to one legal paraphrase.
summary.what_was_special: The apparent legal redundancy opened into distinct mechanics: completion or arrival, maintained memory or recurrent rain, unraveling or reopened strain, and trust or material binding; contextual mirrors and material sequences activated these without forcing a single resolution.
remaining_uncertainties: The reconciliation activation of 13:23 may be weaker than the moral-fitness reading of the same root.
The irrigation and common-ground models are deliberately branch-distant functional analogies and should remain exploratory.
The soul-taking use of و ف ي in 13:40 may remain local rather than revising the behavioral use in 13:20.
